name: Pocket Chess — ChessCom Pipeline
description: Every Chess.com game flows from game completion through cold storage on GCS, then syncs to a local 2TB NVMe drive with queryable indexes. Three chapters: cold storage aggregation, local sync with encoding, and incremental updates.
